node.title: Re^3: how to get Config values into a hash
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
print Dumper $ref_Config; # print() on unopened filehandle Dumper

Looks like you're missing use Data::Dumper; at the top of the script. The error message is a little confusing because Perl is trying to interpret that [doc://print] as [doc://perlobj#Indirect-Object-Syntax] (print FILEHANDLE LIST).

Other than that, looks like you've figured out [doc://@INC], and I already [id://1224211|pointed out] [doc://%INC], which will give you the location of the file that was actually loaded.
